_about: Chaski color and type tokens. Decided D24 (SOT.md). The app imports these; never hard-code a color.
rules: Teal (action) is the only color for primary actions; manta turquoise is decoration, never a button.
Red (block) only means 'Chaski did not say it' or a failed teach-back item. Never decorative, never near a motif.
Warnings always carry an icon, never color alone.

D29 (supersedes D28's striped bands): the motifs ARE the components. Chaski sits in the stepped silhouette inside three nested stepped threads (cobalto outside, amarillo, magenta inside). The mic sits in a nested chakana (turquesa, amarillo, magenta; canela/naranja/amarillo on the quechua turn). Progress, dividers, tags and side buttons use stepped crosses, pixel zigzags and stepped outlines. No stripe bands anywhere.
Motifs never touch the audit row or a status message; audit checks live in plain white chips.
Semantic colors (ok, warn, block) never change and never come from the manta palette.
Motion follows real signals only (mic level, voice envelope, audio progress) and stops under Reduce Motion.

manta._about: Tintes de la manta andina, tomados de las referencias de Freddy. Desde D29 se usan en los motivos-componente (hebras, chakana, crucecitas), nunca como bandas ni en estados.
